messages:
maria-k: Customer POC just asked for per-tenant legal-hold + 7yr retention. They want this available for both Hosted and Dedicated. Need a quick triage: what's the minimal scope for Q3 so we can tell Sales?

jonah: Short take: technically doable via cold archival + export API. Big questions: per-tenant KMS keys (customer-managed), indexability for e-discovery, and who bears storage cost.

linh: Two major infra concerns: 1) keeping logs searchable for legal hold without paying hot-index cost, 2) HSM/KMS rotation + attestations for SOC2 evidence.

pm-ezra: From PM side we need clear launch gates. Can we draft "MVP" vs "Full" feature checklist? Sales wants dates.

security-bot: FYI: SOC2 auditors will request retention policy, key custody evidence, and access logs. See: https://confluence.redwood/security/soc2-evidence

jonah: Proposed MVP (minimal):
- retention tiers exposed in Console (standard + legal-hold)
- export API to pull transcripts in bulk
- store legal-hold data in encrypted S3 bucket (cold) with lifecycle rules
- support customer KMS for encryption-at-rest (optional)

maria-k: Nice. Add launch criteria: proof that exports complete within SLA (eg 48h for 1TB), KMS key binding audit, and automated legal-hold toggle in Console.

linh: Dev notes: sample retention YAML config below for console + infra teams: 
```yaml
retention:
  default_days: 90
  tiers:
    - name: standard
      days: 365
    - name: legal_hold
      days: 2555 # 7 years
      encrypted_with: customer-kms
```

sre-amy: Cost model quick calc: 7yr cold storage for large customers is non-trivial. We should offer 2 billing options: pass-through storage OR flat enterprise add-on. Need finance input.

pm-ezra: Roadmap ask: can we scope MVP for Q3 canary on Dedicated customers only, then Q4 widen to Hosted? That gives us time to add indexer-for-search. Thoughts?

jonah: Agree. Dedicated-first reduces multi-tenant KMS complexity. For Hosted we'll need key wrapping + tenant isolation work.

maria-k: Risks to call out to Sales/legal: export completeness (partial transcripts), e-discovery search freshness, and extra SLA for export times.

linh: Action items: @jonah to own infra design & cost estimate (due EOD Thu), @sre-amy to draft billing options, @pm-ezra to update roadmap PR with canary plan, @maria-k to confirm customer expectations & legal hold wording with customer/legal.

pm-ezra: I'll add these to the OKR planning doc and mark as "needs decision" for next roadmap meeting.

maria-k: Thanks folks. If no objections I'll reply to Sales with Dedicated-first timeline and list of launch gates. :thumbsup:
